steps.text: Only loosen the screws on the side of the front panel – do not unscrew them completely.
Align the front panel upwards or downwards.
notes: A maximum alignment of -3 to +3 mm is possible.
If the screws do not tighten when screwed in tightly, loosen the screws fully, move the furniture panel upwards and downwards until the thread is visible.
